patterns: Direct classification items dominate: 'which is not metamorphic', 'coal is which rock', 'marble is', 'which rock lacks fossils' (granite).
Parent-to-metamorphic pairs (sandstone-quartzite, limestone-marble) and Indian rock systems (Gondwana = coal, Dharwar = metallic minerals, Deccan trap = regur) recur across PSCs.
APPSC-specific: Vindhyan series odd-one-out (Khondalite), AP rock systems with petroleum, crustal elements (oxygen/silicon), felsic vs mafic A-R, Bowen's series, feldspar share.
App MCQs are sound but go deeper (silicate classes, Suess layers, Vindhyan series order, enhanced rock weathering) than typical PYQ single-fact depth.
